gaps.reason: Fifteen workflows across IPv4 UDP, PSK DTLS and IPv6 UDP exercise all seven methods with bounded octet-stream fixture state and specific malformed/overflow refusals. Conditional options, standardized patch formats, IPv6 DTLS and complete option/representation negotiation remain unqualified.
Exact 2000-byte Block2 is qualified only by listed cases; uploads, malformed/missing/duplicate blocks, negotiation and limits need independent cases.
No process notification collector; App tests and same-stack dogfood do not establish independent ordering, cancellation, re-registration or large notifications.
Libcoap OSCORE build support is not exercised by this runner; independent wrong-key/replay/ciphertext/Observe/inner-block cases are absent.
Full independent Q recovery and continuation cases are absent.
Local tests are not a complete independent option/refusal matrix.
Harness discovery tests are separate evidence; this process runner has no discovery or delayed application completion cases.
Mutual certificate and trust-refusal tests use the same Rust DTLS backend; no process X.509 cases against libcoap.
Current Rust DTLS fixtures do not support RFC 7250 RPK; certificate tests are not substitutes.
ETSI cipher offer/selection, Finished and authenticated alert evidence, full loss schedule and actual RPK are not qualified by generic GET success.

IPv6 UDP and PSK DTLS loopback GET/404/Block2 are exercised by five cases each. DTLS additionally checks wrong-key refusal and service afterward through IPv6-only relays. Scoped/link-local IPv6, reordering/delay/MTU and combined schedules remain absent. IPv4 UDP lost reply, duplicate request, blackhole and restart are exercised with Coaptic as client against each alternative server; DTLS/IPv6 faults and compound schedules remain unqualified.
Serial fresh sessions and 140-session churn are not concurrent capacity or long-soak qualification.
Library host CI is separate from this process suite. Process host runs do not establish MCU runtime, stack high-water, endianness or macOS/Windows continuous adapter qualification.
No source-bound full requirements/branch-coverage or seeded campaign evidence in this process suite.

Exploratory dropped-reply and duplicated-request counter POSTs produced two effects in both alternative fixtures. Their passing fault cases qualify idempotent PUT state and Coaptic retransmission identity only; no fixture response cache was added to mask this result.
